title: Avatars
description: A local avatar generator: one Go binary with a CLI, an HTTP API, and an embedded studio, all over one deterministic core.
provenance: Authored 2026-09-11 from the repository at commit 3c936bd. Current elements were traced from cmd/avatars/main.go through internal/cli (cli.go, commands.go, client.go, serve.go, service.go), internal/library, internal/store, internal/httpapi, internal/lifecycle, internal/discovery, pkg/avatar (engine.go, svg.go, png.go, and each style file), and the studio client under internal/studio (studio.go, assets/index.html, app.js, view.mjs, card-grid.mjs, card-physics.mjs, card-sound.mjs, CARD_SYSTEM.md). README.md and docs/guides/active/api-and-integration.md were used for product meaning. Proposed elements come from docs/plans/active/requested-styles-service.md; its Part 1 (service ensure/status/stop) is delivered and modeled as current, later phases are proposed. Comms Web and Tailscale Serve are external and described only as this repository sees them; the Comms Web element rests on the plan document, not on that repository’s code. Intentionally shallow: individual style drawing routines, CSS, and the Matter.js internals are summarized, not modeled.

boundaries.title: One Go binary
boundaries.description: Everything here ships in bin/avatars: the CLI, the core, the store adapter, the HTTP service, and the embedded studio files. No Node runtime, no CGO, no separate frontend build.

boundaries.title: Runs in the browser
boundaries.description: Plain ES modules served from the same origin. The client holds no secrets and keeps only one preference (card sound) locally; everything else is derived from the API and the URL.

boundaries.title: Loopback only, one trusted proxy
boundaries.description: The listener binds a loopback address and refuses any other Host. Remote access exists only when Tailscale Serve is configured and its exact HTTPS origin is passed as --public-url; even then mutations must come from that origin.

boundaries.title: Who may stop the service
boundaries.description: Only avatars service stop, only for an instance started by service ensure, and only through the mode-0600 Unix socket with the matching instance_id. Foreground and supervised services are stopped by their owner; the TCP API has no shutdown route.

boundaries.title: Recipes are the truth, not images
boundaries.description: A saved avatar is style + seed + resolved inputs. Every SVG or PNG is recomputed from that recipe by the same deterministic generators, so the library stays small, diffable, and repairable.

boundaries.title: Adapter seams
boundaries.description: Places designed to be swapped without refactoring the app: style generators and export formats behind the engine registry, the JSONL store behind the Store interface, and in the browser the card physics and sound behind headless adapters.

scenes.title: One binary, three surfaces
scenes.description: Agents use the CLI, browsers use the studio, other apps use the HTTP API — and all of them reach the same core and the same JSONL library.

scenes.title: An agent generates, lists, and exports
scenes.description: The CLI either runs the application core in-process against the local library or, with --url, forwards the identical request to a running service. Either way the output is JSON and stable links.

scenes.title: From seed to image
scenes.description: Inside the core: the engine resolves a style's inputs per seed, asks the generator for native SVG, normalizes the requested size, and hands the artwork to a format adapter.

scenes.title: The local service and its on-demand lifecycle
scenes.description: serve mounts the guarded API and studio on loopback. service ensure probes health, takes a lock, starts a detached child, and proves its identity over a private socket before handing an endpoint to a consuming app.

scenes.title: Inside the studio web client
scenes.description: A framework-free page: the URL is the state, a small API client is the only way out, pure view rules are shared by the toolbar, inspector, and router, and the tactile card grid sits on a headless physics adapter.

scenes.title: How the studio talks to the service
scenes.description: Every studio capability maps to a public /api/v1 route: collections and styles through JSON, thumbnails and previews through image URLs, downloads through the same image routes. Nothing is browser-only.

scenes.title: What runs where, and who may change what
scenes.description: One binary, a same-origin browser client (shown whole), a loopback listener with one trusted proxy, a private shutdown path, and recipes as the only durable truth.

scenes.title: Proposed: styles requested from the studio
scenes.description: Planned work from the active plan. A request becomes an isolated agent attempt, the result is a versioned bundle that plugs into the existing engine, and sign-in plus hosting follow only after the local proof.
